[P2] Identify platform timeouts from structured error types

Searching the entire serialized error also matches application messages and stack traces. An ordinary failure mentioning a database timeout or `timeout_helpers.py` becomes a `platform_timeout`, overwriting the observed invocation outcome with `TIMED_OUT` and supplying incorrect deadline evidence. Inspect recognized platform timeout error types in the structured payload, and apply the same classification in `Cloud.platform_timeout`. Test application errors whose messages or stack traces contain `timeout`.
